name: Charge
description: Demo of the charge block (programFormat 3, firmware 2.9). Per round: the central charges first - hold its button, the ring fills green after 0.2 s and is full after 2 s more (the idle ring drains as a countdown, 8 s). Release = score, release before 0.2 s = red blink, full = the ring flashes. Then pod 0 is charged in accumulate mode (brightness style, 3 s to full): releasing keeps the charge for a moment, it drains over 1.5 s, hold again to go on. Full or 8 s ends the pod's turn. CENTRAL_CHARGE / POD_CHARGE (ms) and the percentages are variables, the metric 'charge' is recorded. Needs one peripheral with firmware 2.9 (link feature 'hold'), else its turn is skipped.
